<svg viewBox="0 0 360 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block">

        <defs>
          <pattern id="grid" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
            <path d="M 20 0 L 0 0 0 20" fill="none" stroke="#e9ddcf" stroke-width="0.5"></path>
          </pattern>
        </defs>
        <rect width="360" height="280" fill="url(#grid)"></rect>
        <!-- clusters will be drawn by JS -->
        <g id="heroDots"></g>
      </svg>
